title: Renewed mind, new heart, flesh crucified
source_text: IX. Praeterea Scriptura speciatim fidelibus tribuit mentem renovatam, Rom. 12. 2. & testatur illos non amplius esse tenebras, sed lucem in Domino, Eph. 5. 8. Dat illis cor novum & Spiritum novum, & affirmat ab illis auferri cor lapideum, & in ejus locum cor carneum substitui, Ezech. 36. 26. ac docet illos carnem crucifixisse cum ejus concupiscentiis, Galat. 5. 24. Quibus in locis describitur per partes sanc-titas & justitia illa quam fidelibus virtute Spiritus Sancti inesse asserimus.
pass_a_gloss: Moreover Scripture especially ascribes to believers a renewed mind (Romans 12:2) and testifies that they are no longer darkness but light in the Lord (Ephesians 5:8). It gives them a new heart and a new Spirit, and affirms that the heart of stone is taken from them and a heart of flesh put in its place (Ezekiel 36:26), and teaches that they have crucified the flesh with its lusts (Galatians 5:24). In which places that holiness and righteousness which we assert is in believers by the power of the Holy Spirit is described by its parts.
pass_b_english: Scripture gives a renewed mind, light in the Lord, new heart and Spirit, flesh crucified with its lusts.
These pieces describe the Spirit-wrought holiness we affirm in the faithful.
